queries.sql:
begin read only;
set local statement_timeout='5s';
with snap as (select statement_timestamp() at),
windows as (select 15 minutes union all select 60),
r as(select j.jobid,j.jobname,w.minutes,s.at,
 count(d.runid) started,
 count(d.runid) filter(where d.status='succeeded') succeeded,
 count(d.runid) filter(where d.status='failed') failed,
 count(d.runid) filter(where d.status not in('succeeded','failed')) other,
 max(d.start_time) latest_started,
 percentile_cont(.50) within group(order by extract(epoch from (d.end_time-d.start_time))*1000) filter(where d.end_time is not null) p50_ms,
 percentile_cont(.95) within group(order by extract(epoch from (d.end_time-d.start_time))*1000) filter(where d.end_time is not null) p95_ms,
 percentile_cont(.99) within group(order by extract(epoch from (d.end_time-d.start_time))*1000) filter(where d.end_time is not null) p99_ms
from cron.job j cross join windows w cross join snap s
left join cron.job_run_details d on d.jobid=j.jobid and d.start_time>=s.at-make_interval(mins=>w.minutes) and d.start_time<=s.at
group by j.jobid,j.jobname,w.minutes,s.at)
select * from r order by jobid,minutes;
rollback;
